run_timer_benchmark: run the timer function to benchmark a callable and get elapsed time with auto-repeat
refine_distances_knn: recompute exact distances between query vectors and candidate indices using L2 or inner product metric
refine_distances_range: recompute distances for range search results in parallel using a thread pool
calculate_distance_ratio: calculate the distance ratio measure between approximate and ground truth distances for a given metric
filter_benchmark_results: filter and optionally apply Pareto-optimal filtering to FAISS benchmark experiment results by accuracy, time, and space
